"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There can be no progressive majoritarian politics in the United States without a politics that appeals to working-class voters of all races.",

"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s rapid growth in the South should be nurtured and sustained.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Strong political headwinds will blow against the Left over the coming years.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If the Left hopes to move U.S. politics in a progressive direction, it must continue down the trail blazed by Bernie Sanders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Multiracial working-class constituencies will support a social democratic program of progressive tax reform, universal access to high-quality health and childcare and public investment in infrastructure and alternative energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
